label: Factory
description: Plan, implement, validate, and independently review local changes
instructions: Use the local factory workflow when requested. /factory-plan prepares or revises a plan, /factory-run executes or resumes an approved plan, and /factory-improve investigates improvements only on explicit request. The main agent owns planning, implementation, validation, and recovery; delegate only the completed implementation to factory-reviewer. Preserve questions, approval boundaries, dependencies, and interrupted-work recovery in the plan. Do not start work from a discussion or plan alone. Do not enable watchdog, turn-end review, background scheduling, or automatic commit/push/PR/merge/deploy. Finish local validation and independent review before reporting implementation complete. Project instructions and the user's authorized scope still apply.
